focus: Public and attributable U.S. campaign financing, lobbying, nonprofit and connected-policy research
purpose: Product-level discovery and evidence provenance registry; references are not equivalent to complete data ingestion.

statuses.indexed_partial: Some related actual records already persisted, but not complete
statuses.curated_excerpt: A bounded, attributed research extract is present
statuses.link_only: Public source documented and linked; no transactions ingested from this source
statuses.research_only: Analysis or academic contextual source not yet ingested

links: Only observed filing-linked entities form graph edges; matching names, money and votes do not establish improper influence.
privacy: No personal addresses, phones, emails or individual donation transactions are republished in this index.

sources.name: Federal Election Commission
sources.coverage: Federal candidates, PACs, party committees, outside spending · historical and current
sources.value: Verify who filed, what a committee received, and reported independent spending.
sources.access: Official bulk data + public API; API key or rate limits can apply
sources.caution: Already indexed committee identifiers and aggregates; no complete donor-to-recipient disbursement ledger.

sources.name: IRS political organization disclosures
sources.value: Find political-organization income and expenditure filings outside the FEC view.
sources.caution: Many FEC-registered committees have separate reporting rules; don't infer an absent IRS filing is undisclosed campaign money.

sources.name: U.S. House and Senate LDA / LD-203
sources.coverage: Federal lobbying registration, quarterly activity, lobbyist political contribution reports
sources.value: Examine disclosed lobbying issue activity alongside campaign finance.
sources.access: Public search; API registration required for programmatic access
sources.caution: 56 previously indexed issue-query filings are LD-1/LD-2-style activity matches, not an ingested set of LD-203 donor disclosures or proof of a payoff.

sources.name: California Secretary of State · CAL-ACCESS
sources.coverage: State campaigns, ballot measures, independent expenditures and lobbying
sources.value: Follow CA campaign money and ballot-measure spending.
sources.access: Daily raw export + source field guides; ZIP parsing required
sources.caution: No state contribution transactions ingested; daily export can include sensitive fields. Use redacted published extracts only.

sources.name: New York State Board of Elections
sources.coverage: NY state and county campaign-finance disclosures since July 1999
sources.value: Search state filers, contributions, independent expenditures, and annual filings.
sources.access: Public report search and CSV ZIP; also state open data
sources.caution: NYC mayor, council and some other NYC office records have a separate city filing system. Duplicated amended reports require reconciliation.

sources.name: New York City Campaign Finance Board
sources.coverage: New York City candidates and political spending, including off-year elections
sources.value: Explore municipal donations, spending, intermediaries and public matching funds.
sources.caution: Municipal city-office finance differs from the statewide NY BOE and federal election-cycle data.

sources.name: Texas Ethics Commission
sources.coverage: State candidates, PACs, expenditures, and lobbying reports
sources.value: Open TX campaign disclosures and regularly refreshed CSV extracts.
sources.access: Nightly CSV ZIP published by the state
sources.caution: Filer corrections and duplicate special reports require deduplication; many local-office records reside with local authorities.

sources.name: New Jersey ELEC
sources.coverage: State and local candidate committees, PACs, lobbying and pay-to-play records
sources.value: Search NJ campaign contributions and contracting-related disclosures.
sources.access: Public search, selected bulk links; some historical material restricted for privacy review
sources.caution: Public source availability is narrower than all historical filings. Do not attempt to bypass address redactions.

sources.name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
sources.coverage: IRS Form 990 and tax-exempt organization financial summaries
sources.value: Inspect a nonprofit's filings, revenue and expenditures when investigating groups active in politics.
sources.access: Public REST API; use rate-aware, attributed requests
sources.caution: Form 990 annual totals are not equivalent to campaign expenditures, and a 501(c)(4) donor list may not be publicly disclosed.

sources.name: OpenSecrets / Follow the Money
sources.coverage: Federal and selected state money-in-politics rankings and classifications
sources.value: Add donor employer, sector and organization context to official finance filings.
sources.access: Public research pages; bulk extraction and reuse rights require explicit terms review
sources.caution: Only 18 selected presidential-cycle donor rows currently included; not a full donor universe.

sources.name: Brennan Center election money research
sources.coverage: Research on mega donors, dark money and federal elections
sources.value: Compare the largest midterm donor groups, especially undisclosed-donor organizations.
sources.access: Published curated source tables with attribution
sources.caution: 160 rows cover four selected midterms only. Grouped donors and 'dark money' classifications follow source methodology.

sources.name: Stanford DIME · Political Money & Ideology
sources.coverage: 1979–2024 linked donors, candidates and ideology scores
sources.value: Track historical donor identities and estimated ideology across cycles and electoral levels.
sources.access: Published aggregates and selected files with ODC-BY attribution; donor-level row-level restrictions apply to some third-party-sourced records
sources.caution: CFscores are model estimates, not positions on specific bills. Confirm licensing and restricted records before redistribution.

sources.name: Plural / OpenStates legislative records
sources.coverage: State legislation, sponsors, votes, and legislator rosters
sources.value: Check whether recipients later sponsored or voted on specific measures.
sources.access: Free limited research API with registration; separate commercial terms
sources.caution: Temporal association of donations with votes does not imply donor influence or causality.

sources.name: Campaign Legal Center
sources.coverage: Campaign finance cases, regulatory complaints, dark-money investigative briefs
sources.value: Track legal questions and enforcement status involving political spending.
sources.caution: A filed complaint is an allegation, not a finding of wrongdoing.

sources.name: Common Cause
sources.coverage: Money-in-politics issues, disclosure reform and public financing
sources.value: Provide institutional reform context and supporting research.
sources.caution: Advocacy content is a secondary perspective; verify numerical or legal claims against primary filings.

sources.name: MapLight / California Power Search
sources.coverage: Public California Secretary of State Power Search tool, built by MapLight
sources.value: Search CA campaign and ballot-measure donors in a readable interface.
sources.access: Public search; not an unrestricted bulk data API
sources.caution: State-level electronic filings only; not a national or independent MapLight live database.

sources.name: Sunlight Foundation archive
sources.value: Preserve historical methodology and civic-tech context.
sources.caution: Foundation ceased active operations in 2020. Do not use as a live data feed.
